cohort: Released eval recipe: at most 30 robot rows per dataset with random.Random(42), then successful rows only contribute VOC. Report our exact release indices; author original episode IDs are not published.
goal_protocol: Each successful episode final image is its own exact PSI/DINO goal. No failure or suboptimal outcome evaluation.
robometer_protocol: Native progress bin expectation, no goal; eight causal context frames from official nearest-integer linspace and right-padding helpers. Query current-frame prediction at five released-recipe timestamps.
common_grid: Replace first paper query (frame 0) by frame 4 for fair S5 history; all models evaluated on these five common timestamps. Separate Robometer released-grid value includes frame 0.
voc: Pearson native score vs actual released frame number per successful trajectory. Undefined constant correlation -> 0 as upstream. Mean per dataset, then equal-weight mean across six datasets. Also endpoint-excluded on common grid. DT uses negative distance; S uses negative surprisal.
scoring_caveat: Hindsight goal-conditioned progress alignment; endpoint observation equals goal. Endpoint exclusion does not make goals prospective. Public physical timing unknown.
